standard.summary: 将 autograd 保存的激活张量在 GPU 上压缩为低精度，减少反向传播时的激活内存占用。
standard.effect: activation_compression_dtype 选择压缩格式（fp16/bf16/fp8_e4m3）。activation_compression_min_tensor_mb 设置最小压缩阈值。
standard.whenToUse: 激活内存成为瓶颈时（不用 gradient_checkpointing 但显存不够）。
standard.avoidWhen: 已启用 gradient_checkpointing 时不需要（GC 已经大幅减少激活）。压缩可能引入精度损失。

standard_en.summary: Compresses the activation tensors saved by autograd to a lower precision on the GPU, cutting the activation memory needed for the backward pass.
standard_en.effect: activation_compression_dtype picks the format (fp16 / bf16 / fp8_e4m3). activation_compression_min_tensor_mb sets the minimum size that gets compressed.
standard_en.whenToUse: When activation memory is the bottleneck -- you are not using gradient_checkpointing and still run out of VRAM.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Unnecessary once gradient_checkpointing is on, since GC has already cut activations drastically. Compression can also introduce precision loss.

advanced.principle: PyTorch autograd 在 forward 时保存中间激活用于 backward 计算。这些激活通常是 FP32/BF16 且占用大量显存。activation_compression 拦截 save_for_backward，将激活转换为低精度（FP16/BF16/FP8），backward 时自动反量化。fp8_e4m3 可将激活显存减少 75%（FP32→FP8），但精度损失更大。min_tensor_mb 避免压缩太小的张量（开销不划算）。
advanced.intervention: hook autograd save_for_backward → dtype cast to lower precision → dequantize on backward access。
advanced.expectedImpact: 激活显存减少 50-75%。对训练质量的影响取决于 dtype 和模型。
advanced.tradeoffs: FP8 压缩可能影响梯度质量。建议先用 FP16/BF16。

advanced_en.principle: PyTorch autograd saves intermediate activations during forward for backward computation. These activations are usually FP32/BF16 and consume a lot of VRAM. activation_compression intercepts save_for_backward, casting activations to lower precision (FP16/BF16/FP8), with automatic dequantization on backward access. fp8_e4m3 can cut activation VRAM by 75% (FP32→FP8) at a larger precision cost. min_tensor_mb avoids compressing tensors too small to be worth it.
advanced_en.intervention: hook autograd save_for_backward → dtype cast to lower precision → dequantize on backward access.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Activation VRAM reduced 50-75%. Impact on training quality depends on dtype and model.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: FP8 compression can affect gradient quality. Start with FP16/BF16.
